name: chatapp
description: ChatApp monorepo — React frontend + Node/Express/Prisma backend

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix backend --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
